programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Trump Will Lead To America's Downfall
programme.desc: Owen Jones makes his PolJOE debut to discuss Western decline and his book The Fall of the West. He examines economic, military, and moral crises, from Western support for Israel to Donald Trump and rising authoritarianism. Jones explores the legacy of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, deindustrialisation, stagnant wages, and the financial crash, arguing that decades of concentrated wealth have led to decline.

programme.title: The Dark Money Behind Keir Starmer's Rise
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Peter Geoghegan discusses Labour Together, the organisation that shaped Keir Starmer's leadership project. Geoghegan explains how the group functioned less like a traditional thinktank and more like a political campaign machine backed by significant undeclared funding. That money, he argues, was used to build the polling, messaging, and strategy that underpinned Starmer's rise.

programme.title: The Grand Tour's Francis, Thomas & James Take On The British Test

From hilarious cast banter to emotional reflections on the show's journey, this interview dives deep into the Upside Down one last time.

programme.desc: Six months on from their last sit-down, Poole MP Neil Duncan-Jordan returns to PoliticsJOE at a pivotal moment for Labour's future. With interventions this week from Keir Starmer, Tony Blair, Andy Burnham and Wes Streeting, the battle for Labour's direction is underway. Duncan-Jordan discusses Socialism26, a proposal aimed at reshaping the party's priorities and reconnecting it with voters.

programme.title: Nicholas Galitzine & Camila Mendes Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Camila Mendes and Nicholas Galitzine from Masters of the Universe take on The British Test, tackling Britain's biggest cultural talking points. They attempt to make the perfect cup of tea, give their honest verdict on British food, debate whether Idris Elba should be the next James Bond, discuss their favourite British TV shows, and try Colin the Caterpillar cake.

programme.title: Ireland legend Louise Quinn Interview
programme.desc: Louise Quinn is a former professional footballer who played on the Irish squad for 17 years, garnering 122 caps and 16 goals as a centre back for the girls in green. She reflects on some of her career highlights including training in freezing temperatures, lifting the cup with Arsenal and her final game in the Irish jersey.

programme.title: I Humiliated A GB News Host On Live TV
programme.desc: Andy debriefs his televised clash with Matt Goodwin over accusations that the Gorton and Denton by-election candidate used AI to research his book. Seán and Andy revisit the best moments of the debate, from Goodwin's evasive answers to his use of ChatGPT to defend himself.

programme.title: How The Taliban Really Works
programme.desc: Sean Langan is a British journalist and documentary filmmaker who has spent decades reporting from some of the world's most dangerous conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq and Russia. He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

It's packed with a spectacular range of habitats and environments, and home to some of the best loved and dramatic wildlife on the planet. From the small and surprising to the enormous and entertaining, there's something for everyone's bucket list on this vast continent. From camels to giraffes, gorillas to buffalo, the sheer range of wildlife found in Africa is unbelievable. With so much to see, where would you begin your bucket list adventure?

programme.title: The Pull of the Wild
programme.desc: Since the dawn of time, snakes have fostered our fascination, playing a significant role in our most ancient stories. Follow environmental photojournalist Aaron Gekoski as he investigates our relationship with one of the planet's most popular exotic pets: ball pythons. Traversing four continents, he witnesses sacred rituals, visits voodoo markets and joins expeditions into remote West Africa to discover how ball pythons make their way into the homes of pet owners, worldwide.

programme.title: Polar Bear Family
programme.desc: The ultimate icons of polar wilderness, able to withstand the harshest environments and remain a top predator the lives of polar bears are nothing short of remarkable!

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: Mountains define some of our most spectacular landscapes, creating a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. Mountains are found on every continent on Earth, covering 22% of the planet's surface. They're a vital part of our ecosystem a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds. It's no wonder that so many cultures consider mountains sacred places: gateways to the heavens.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Antelope
programme.desc: For some the word ‘antelope' might not incite much interest but look closer and you'll discover a remarkably diverse group of animals, numbering nearly one hundred different species. Some are easy to miss, the little dik-dik being barely the size of a house cat, while eland weigh in at more than half a ton. There are representatives roaming plains from the Mongolian Plateau in Asia to the cape of South Africa. Wherever you find them, these remarkable animals are the unsung heroes of the plains.

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: This episode is about the capercaillie and the story also begins in the far north: Biologists capture wild animals in central Sweden and take them to Germany. In the Nature Park Niederlausitz the black grouse are reintroduced to the nature reserve in an area, that was dominated by coal opencast mining until recently

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It's a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It's a country that's astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S3 E03
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S3 E02
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S3 E04
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: The Green Heart of Croatia
programme.sub-title: At the Banks of River Sava
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river's delta in the Netherlands, flows through six countries and ends in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest on earth and didn't evolve until after the last Ice Age. It seems so familiar, yet offers many surprises. The shores of the Baltic Sea are still shaped by wind and waves. The first episode takes us from Denmark's northernmost corner, via the Darss Peninsula in Germany and Lithuania's Curonian Spit to the endless beaches of Latvia. The film begins at the gateway to the Baltic Sea at Denmark's northernmost point: Skagen. It is here that the North Sea and the Baltic Sea meet and form a divide made of sand between Skagerrak and Kattegat. In June, hundreds of seals gather together on the lonely island of Anholt between Denmark and Sweden. It is the largest seal colony in the Baltic Sea. No camera team has ever been able to get so close to the animals as nature filmmaker Christoph Hauschild. Using remote-control cameras, he and his team have been able to capture intimate images of the way the seals live over and beneath water. For the very first time they follow a mother with her young to swimming lessons and in doing so, capture very emotional moments of these timid creatures. Most of the freshwater from the North Sea to the Baltic Sea, flows through the Store Baelt. In this sound, the underwater world is characterised by many species of saltwater loving fish. In the waters around Sjaelland, the largest stocks of harbour porpoise in the Baltic Sea. In 2016, the labyrinth of islands, sounds and fjords attracted two dolphins. They spent several months in the fjords of Flensburg and Kiel. Astounding images: they show familiar to us from the Mediterranean, but not something we would necessarily expect from the Baltic Sea.

programme.title: Street of Gongs
programme.desc: In Thailand's rural northeast you will find the street of Gongs. Outside the provincial capital of Ubon Ratchatani in Thailand's rural northeast, a country road nearly thirty kilometers long stretches to the banks of the Mekong River. Even from a distance, you can hear what is being made there: gongs of all sizes in nearly 50 manufactories. The gong is considered the ancient instrument and symbol of Asia. It occupies an important cultural significance, initiates rituals, expels demons, gives strength and courage. This film visits the creators of these unique instruments - a family business that has been laboriously handcrafting gongs for generations. They have a big mission: The abbot of the temple has ordered a new, large gong for the upcoming festival. Will they be able to finish it in time?

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Only One Can Remain
programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. They meet the playfully deceitful ruler who tells them they are in a tournament where ‘Only one can remain'. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29
programme.desc: To protect Jeongi, Gwanghae arranges for a personal guard to stay by her side. When pigments needed for overglaze painting run short, Mun Saseung turns to Hwa-ryeong for supplies—drawing Gangcheon straight to her. Thanks to Jeongi's foresight in testing Gangcheon's scheme in advance, Mun Saseung successfully completes the tribute porcelain. Enraged by his failure, Gangcheon orders Mapung to kill Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.32
programme.desc: With the Bunwon seized by Japanese forces, Jeongi attempts to slip away to meet Gwanghae but is captured by Gangcheon. After learning the full truth from Mun Saseung, Yukdo agonizes over his choice—then ultimately releases Jeongi. Trusting that Gwanghae will drive the invaders away, Jeongi returns to the Bunwon and waits for his promise to be fulfilled.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.1

Meanwhile, Ri Jin searches for her missing patient, Heo Sook Hee, at Club Paradise, where she unexpectedly runs into Do Hyun — but he seems like a completely different person.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: Gloria Guida è la sfrontata adolescente Angela, figlia del vedovo Dr. Batrucchi. Quando conosce la nuova compagna del padre, Irene (Dagmar Lassander), presa d'antipatia tenta con vari sotterfugi di screditarla agli occhi dell'uomo. Ma Angela scoprirà presto una macchia nel passato d'Irene: tendenze lesbiche e una relazione tempestosa con un'insegnante di liceo, condotta quest'ultima al suicidio.

programme.title: Sandrine nella pioggia
programme.desc: Sandrine (Sara Forestier) è una ragazza seducente, una provocatrice dall'aria angelica e dai comportamenti equivoci, che con ogni tipo di astuzia femminile tenta di irretire il giovane Leonardo (Adriano Giannini). Lui è un ex poliziotto in prima linea che ha deciso di dedicarsi al lavoro d'ufficio, dopo aver ucciso una ragazza, tempo prima, nel tentativo di fermare alcuni banditi.

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Tinto Brass dirige l'avvenente Serena Grandi. Inizio anni Cinquanta, nella campagna ferrarese, Miranda gestisce una locanda in attesa del ritorno del marito Gino, disperso in guerra. Nel frattempo la donna si concede numerose scappatelle: l'autotrasportatore Berto, Carlo l'ex fascista al confino, Norman e per finire c'è Toni, il cameriere della locanda che non osa, però, manifestare il suo amore.

programme.title: L'insegnante di violoncello
programme.desc: Arriva l'estate e Mario, giovane di buona famiglia, rifugge la noia prendendo lezioni di violoncello. A tenere il corso è la splendida e giunonica insegnante Margherita che con il suo fascino procace non tarda a turbare i sogni del volenteroso allievo.

programme.title: Il Federale
programme.desc: Negli ultimi giorni del fascismo, un miliziano zelante riceve l'ordine di catturare un professore antifascista e portarlo a Roma. Il viaggio attraverso un'Italia in disfacimento cambierà progressivamente le sue certezze.

programme.title: Noi Duri
programme.desc: A Parigi un improbabile agente di polizia si trova sulle tracce di una banda di trafficanti di droga. Tra locali notturni, scambi di persona e gag, l'indagine diventa una parodia movimentata del poliziesco.

programme.title: Costa azzurra
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi e Giovanna Ralli in una divertentissima commedia. Due coniugi romani arrivano in Costa Azzurra perché la moglie spera di sfondare nel cinema nonostante le perplessità del marito. Quando però il regista propone una parte proprio al marito, anziché alla moglie, è proprio l'uomo che inizia ad illudersi.

programme.title: Souvenir d'Italie
programme.desc: Tre giovani straniere attraversano l'Italia in autostop, dalla Riviera a Venezia, Pisa e Roma. Lungo il viaggio incontrano uomini, occasioni e piccoli imprevisti che trasformano la vacanza in una serie di avventure sentimentali, offrendo un ritratto leggero e romantico dell'Italia degli anni Cinquanta.

programme.title: Carmela è una bambola
programme.desc: Carmela è promessa dal padre a un uomo che non ama e tenta di sottrarsi al matrimonio combinato. Il suo sonnambulismo e una serie di incontri notturni alimentano equivoci e complicazioni sentimentali.

programme.title: Rappresaglia
programme.desc: Roma 23 Marzo 1944. Le truppe tedesche tengono la città sotto il loro controllo. In seguito ad un attentato contro una compagnia delle SS compiuto in via Rasella, il generale Maelzer informa i suoi capi a Berlino che, decisi ad abrogare qualunque soglia di tolleranza, ordinano una veloce rappresaglia, pretendendo l`esecuzione di dieci italiani per ogni tedesco ucciso. Sarà il tenente colonnello Herbert Kapller a gestire l`intervento e a compilare la lista dei sacrificati, nonostante il suo aperto dissenso.

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Il fotografo ventiseienne Dennis Stock è molto più maturo dei suoi anni e ancora legato alla vita familiare quando nel 1955 riceve il compito di fotografare per il magazine Life l'astro nascente James Dean, uno spirito libero destinato a divenire un idolo e a cambiare per sempre la cultura popolare. L'assegnazione del servizio porterà Dennis e James ad affrontare un viaggio per gli States, che plasmerà Stock e consegnerà alla storia alcune delle immagini più iconiche del periodo.

programme.title: Un affare di famiglia
programme.desc: Dopo una delle loro sessioni di taccheggio, Osamu e il figlio si imbattono in una bambina lasciata al freddo. Seppur dapprima riluttante, la moglie di Osamu accetta di prendersene cura dopo avere appreso le difficoltà che la piccola deve affrontare. Sebbene la famiglia sia povera e guadagni solo lo stretto necessario per sopravvivere, tutti sono felici finché un incidente imprevisto porta alla luce segreti tenuti ben nascosti, mettendo alla prova ogni legame.

programme.title: M4M
programme.desc: Un'interpretazione di "Misura per misura" di William Shakespeare, ambientata nelle famigerate case popolari di Melbourne, che fanno da sfondo a un'esplorazione di amore, lealtà e giustizia.

programme.title: Critical Thinking
programme.desc: Basato su una storia vera del 1998, cinque adolescenti latini e neri provenienti dal ghetto più difficile di Miami lottano per entrare nel campionato nazionale di scacchi sotto la guida del loro insegnante anticonvenzionale ma ispiratore.

programme.title: East Is East
programme.desc: Nel 1971 George Khan, pakistano tradizionalista, è emigrato nel Regno Unito dove possiede un negozio di fish & chips e ha sposato Ella. I loro sette figli sembrano poco inclini a seguire le direttive paterne per quanto riguarda la religione islamica.

programme.title: Lo smemorato di Collegno
programme.desc: Un uomo in ospedale soffre di amnesia. Dopo aver visto la sua foto sul giornale, due signore affermano che è il loro marito. L'uomo viene portato in tribunale con l'accusa di essere un famoso ladro, il signor LoBianco.

programme.title: Senza santi in paradiso
programme.desc: Bob e Ruth sono una coppia di fuorilegge che vengono catturati dopo una sparatoria. Bob si prende la colpa dell'accaduto e Ruth viene rilasciata e porta avanti una gravidanza. Dopo quattro anni Bob evade per conoscere la figlia mai vista finora.

programme.title: Bello Onesto Emigrato Australia Sposerebbe Compaesana Illibata
programme.desc: Bellissima commedia con Alberto Sordi e Claudia Cardinale. Un operaio emigrato in Australia cerca moglie per corrispondenza usando la foto di un amico. Lo raggiunge, senza rivelarsi, una ex prostituta. Le reciproche bugie creano divertenti malintesi.

programme.title: Good
programme.desc: John Halder (Viggo Mortensen) è un docente di letteratura tedesco i cui studi saranno utilizzati come propaganda al regime nazionalsocialista, portando così un uomo tranquillo a tradire il buono della sua vita.

programme.title: We are your Friends
programme.desc: Cole, un giovane dj, fa la conoscenza del più esperto e famoso collega James Reed, e trova in lui una guida capace di dare una svolta alla sua carriera finora deludente. Contemporaneamente Cole si innamora di Sophie.

programme.title: Labirinti e mostri
programme.desc: Robbie ei suoi compagni di college sono tutti ossessionati dal gioco di ruolo "Labirinti e mostri". Tuttavia, i giochi prendono una strana piega quando Robbie inizia a sperimentare visioni dopo aver giocato una sessione in un mistico punto di riferimento locale.

programme.title: Quel momento imbarazzante
programme.desc: Tre migliori amici si fanno una promessa: quella di restare tutti single. Hanno infatti timore che le relazioni serie possano annullare le loro personalità e far cambiare il loro rapporto di amicizia. Nel momento in cui meno se lo aspettano però tre ragazze gli faranno cambiare idea.

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Nick pensa di aver trovato il paradiso quando raggiunge il fratello in Colombia. Una laguna turchese, una spiaggia d'avorio, onde perfette - è un sogno per questo giovane surfista canadese. Poi incontra Maria, una splendida ragazza colombiana.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Undead or alive
programme.desc: Cowboy contro zombie in un West delirante. Tra gag, inseguimenti e non-morti, sopravvivere è l'unica missione.

programme.title: 47 Metri: Great White
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente aereo, cinque amici si ritrovano su una zattera in mezzo al mare, senza cibo né aiuto in vista. Gli squali affamati pattugliano ogni loro mossa, trasformando il mare in una trappola mortale. Sopravvivere sembra impossibile, ma arrendersi non è un'opzione.

programme.title: Daybreakers L'ultimo vampiro
programme.desc: Un'epidemia ha trasformato quasi tutti gli umani in vampiri, costringendo i pochi superstiti a nascondersi. Edward Dalton, un vampiro che rifiuta il sangue umano, lavora per creare un'alternativa sintetica e salvare l'umanità con l'aiuto della sopravvissuta Audrey.

programme.title: Shriver
programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: L'amore in equilibrio
programme.desc: Refugio, sognatore cresciuto in un circo tra magia e poesia, parte dal Messico verso New Orleans alla ricerca del vero amore. L'incontro con Kay, ballerina dal passato oscuro, e con Juan, il padre che non sapeva di avere, intreccia destini, segreti e redenzione in un viaggio di speranza e passione.

programme.title: The land girls – Ragazze di campagna
programme.desc: Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale, le donne inglesi vengono reclutate per essere mandate a lavorare nei campi al posto degli uomini diretti al fronte. Ag - interpretata dal premio Oscar Rachel Weisz -, Stella e Prue, tre donne provenienti da ambienti sociali diversi, si ritrovano quindi a vivere in una fattoria sperduta. Qui, l'incontro con l'affascinante Joe cambierà per sempre la loro vita.

programme.title: Anime in fiamme
programme.desc: Katie Holmes e Luke Kirby interpretano due poeti affetti da disturbo bipolare che iniziano una storia d'amore che metterà i loro cuori (e le loro menti) a dura prova.

programme.title: Uno studente da incubo
programme.desc: Brianna è ferita quando scopre che il suo fidanzato Nick la tradisce con la sua collega Christina, così Brianna si confida con uno sconosciuto online, ma ben presto la sua vita si sgretola quando si rende conto che non è uno sconosciuto.

programme.title: Brace for Impact: indagine ad alta quota
programme.desc: Una detective dell'FBI perde il fratello in un incidente aereo e decidere di indagare sull'accaduto per conto proprio, rompendo le regole del servizio di intelligence e scoprendo un complotto terroristico.

programme.title: Burden of Evil
programme.desc: Quando la figlia di un potente senatore viene rapita da uno psicopatico, l'uomo pretende che ad occuparsi delle indagini sia la detective della squadra omicidi Caitlyn Conner.

programme.title: D'amore e d'accordo
programme.desc: Poppy è una specialista di marketing la cui vita viene sconvolta quando finge un fidanzamento con Milo, l'affascinante nuovo cliente del suo capo, per conquistare il severo amministratore del palazzo e ottenere per Milo l'attico.

programme.title: Guida per cuori solitari
programme.desc: Molly, un'abile e scrupolosa content creator, riceve l'inaspettato incarico di raccontare la sua nuova vita da single. Ma quando viene affiancata a Jackson, il suo opposto totale, imparerà a cavarsela da sola, o l'amore finirà per mettersi in mezzo?

programme.title: The Clue to Love
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Audrey Harper si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere sulla speciale ma anonima rubrica di consigli amorosi Chiedi a zia Hope, un pilastro del giornale locale della città. Incontra così l'affascinante caporedattore Morgan Cooper, che la aiuta a scoprire la vera identità della "zia Hope".

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Basato sulla saga di best seller mondiali scritta dall'americana Lauren Kate, FALLEN ha per protagonista Lucinda “Luce” Price, una diciassettenne dalla forte forza di volontà che apparentemente sembra vivere una vita normale, fino a quando non viene accusata di un crimine che non ha commesso.

programme.title: Il Fidanzato Di Mia Sorella
programme.desc: Un carismatico professore di poesia di Cambridge, che vive a Los Angeles, vede la sua vita spensierata stravolta quando una studentessa con cui ha una relazione rimane incinta.

programme.title: Una pasticceria da amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una pasticcera di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando dei costruttori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio costringendola ad andarsene, dovrà fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua pasticceria.

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Nick pensa di aver trovato il paradiso quando raggiunge il fratello in Colombia. Una laguna turchese, una spiaggia d'avorio, onde perfette - è un sogno per questo giovane surfista canadese. Poi incontra Maria, una splendida ragazza colombiana.

programme.title: Amore inaspettato
programme.desc: Bill, scrittore di successo, resta cieco a causa di un incidente stradale, nel quale sua moglie perde la vita. Un giorno si presenta alla sua porta Suzanne, obbligata ai servizi sociali a causa di una condanna penale. All'inizio i due non si piacciono, ma ben presto si scopriranno innamorati.

programme.title: Family therapy
programme.desc: Aleksander è ossessionato dall'immagine della sua famiglia perfetta, tanto da voler partecipare a un concorso per vincere un viaggio nello spazio. L'equilibrio precario esplode quando il figlio di una precedente relazione si unisce al nucleo familiare, scoperchiando bugie e segreti taciuti.

programme.title: Un padre in prestito
programme.desc: Per poter adottare un ragazzo problematico, un impiegato postale solitario e non sposato deve dimostrare di essere emotivamente qualificato per amare e accudire un bambino.

programme.title: Un Natale di ricordi
programme.desc: Con l'avvicinarsi del Natale, Darcy e Aiden sono rattristati dall'imminente chiusura del centro ricreativo della loro comunità. Per salvare il loro amato centro, e con esso lo spirito natalizio, Darcy e Aiden intraprendono un magico viaggio di amore e felicità, dove un ospite inaspettato unisce tutti per una vacanza indimenticabile.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da ricordare
programme.desc: Ai lati opposti di un progetto di sviluppo, Olivia e Brian sono sorpresi di scoprire di essere la damigella d'onore e il testimone dello stesso matrimonio. Devono mettere da parte i loro sentimenti per salvare il matrimonio dei loro amici...

programme.title: La ricetta perfetta
programme.desc: Un esperto culinario ha il compito di elevare la personalità del marchio di un canale alimentare. Mentre le loro personalità si scontrano, iniziano a rendersi conto che il contrasto può essere positivo tanto in amore quanto lo è nel cibo.

programme.title: La mappa dellamore
programme.desc: Una giornalista che sta per lanciare un'app di appuntamenti ha il compito di scrivere una mappa dei luoghi più romantici della Florida. L'unico problema è che deve lavorare con una guida turistica i cui gusti sono opposti ai suoi.

programme.title: Dopo luragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012. Il giovane deve ricostruire il ristorante di famiglia, completamente distrutto, ma incontra sulla propria strada un mecenate che crede in lui e l'amore.

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: La Regina degli scacchi
programme.desc: Maria Adele, 17 anni, vive per gli scacchi, ma scopre di essere stata adottata e, con l'aiuto di un giornalista, rintraccia la madre biologica. Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.title: Dalle 5 Alle 7
programme.desc: Un aspirante romanziere comincia una relazione con una donna, anche se c'è solo un problema: la donna è sposata e la coppia può incontrarsi solo tra le 5 e le 7 ogni sera.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: La Comune
programme.desc: Erik e Anna, con la figlia Freja, creano una comune nella villa di famiglia a Copenhagen. Tra amicizie, feste e sogni condivisi, l'equilibrio viene spezzato da una relazione inaspettata che metterà alla prova il legame tra i membri della comunità.

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Un divano a tunisi
programme.desc: Selma, giovane psicanalista, torna a Tunisi all'indomani della Primavera araba, decisa ad aprire uno studio privato si scontrerà con un ambiente sfavorevole.

programme.title: Biuti Quin Olivia
programme.desc: Nei primi anni ottanta in una periferia di Roma cresce Olivia, una ragazza con un carattere difficile e ribelle rovinata da una situazione familiare difficile. La madre cameriera viene licenziata e il padre è un invalido civile violento e volgare. A scuola incontra una ragazza, Lili, con la quale litiga spesso. Quel che sembrava una rivalità ostile, diventerà invece una solida amicizia. Lili organizza a scuola un concorso chiamato appunto Biuti Quin Olivia alla quale partecipa volentieri anche Olivia.I genitori però non vogliono. Infine le due amiche cercheranno il vero padre di Olivia.

programme.title: Quel Nano Infame
programme.desc: Un boss malavitoso offre al ladro di gioielli (alto circa 90 cm e rilasciato di recente con la condizionale) Calvin Sims e al suo partner Percy 100.000 dollari per rubare un famoso diamante. Ma la rapina fallisce e Calvin fa cadere il gioiello nella borsetta di Vanessa Edwards.

programme.title: Quel Nano Infame
programme.desc: Un boss malavitoso offre al ladro di gioielli (alto circa 90 cm e rilasciato di recente con la condizionale) Calvin Sims e al suo partner Percy 100.000 dollari per rubare un famoso diamante. Ma la rapina fallisce e Calvin fa cadere il gioiello nella borsetta di Vanessa Edwards.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: Il lanciatore della lega minore Gus Cantrell sta per essere mandato in pensione quando riceve l'opportunità di fare la prossima cosa migliore: gestire i South Carolina Buzz. La squadra di baseball in difficoltà è piena di giocatori terribili, ma il proprietario Roger Dorn conta su Cantrell per trasformarli in una franchigia di prima classe.

programme.title: Scappo dalla città 2
programme.desc: In questo sequel, Mitch Robbins (Billy Crystal) e il fratello Glen (Jon Lovitz), la pecora nera della famiglia, trovano per caso una vecchia mappa del tesoro nella fascia del cappello del defunto Curly. Dopo aver scoperto che il padre di Curly aveva partecipato a un famoso furto ad un treno, si chiedono se la mappa nasconda davvero la chiave ad un tesoro.

programme.title: Aragosta a colazione
programme.desc: Enrico fallisce il suicidio e finisce nei guai recitando la parte del marito per un amico

programme.title: Il lumacone
programme.desc: Gianni, cuoco solo e abbandonato, realizza il sogno di un ristorante in un vagone grazie a Ginetto.

programme.title: La governante
programme.desc: La nuova governante francese Caterina Leher sconvolge la famiglia Platania, portando caos e tragedie

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Fifa e arena
programme.desc: Commedia di Mario Mattoli con Totò e Isa Barzizza: per un equivoco Nicolino è scambiato per un criminale e fugge a Siviglia. Tra gag, travestimenti e corrida, combinano guai esilaranti in una Spagna tutta napoletana.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Totò cerca casa
programme.desc: Totò è un uomo alla ricerca disperata di una casa, ma si trova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni esilaranti e complicate. Tra inganni e malintesi, il film esplora con ironia le difficoltà della vita quotidiana.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: L'amore secondo Dan
programme.desc: Dan Burns (Steve Carell) è un giornalista esperto in questioni familiari. Rimasto vedovo, si è rifugiato in una rassicurante routine, in cui cerca di scansare come la peste qualsiasi novità o imprevisto, con l'arduo compito di tenere a bada tre figlie adolescenti e ribelli.

programme.title: Sotto Il Cielo Delle Hawaii
programme.desc: Un famoso militare professionista ritorna sul luogo dei suoi più grandi trionfi legati al programma spaziale degli Stati Uniti a Honolulu, Hawaii. Qui incontra una sua ex, ma altrettanto inaspettatamente si innamora della giovane pilota dell'Air Force a lui assegnata.

programme.title: American Ultra
programme.desc: Mike vive con la sua fidanzata Phoebe in una piccola cittadina americana, dove il suo passatempo preferito è l'uso abbondante di droghe. A sua insaputa, però, Mike è anche un agente super addestrato e letale e improvvisamente, quando il suo passato segreto torna a tormentarlo...

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: In questa commedia esilarante Valentín è un playboy di Acapulco che vive una vita eccentrica e senza responsabilità. Un giorno sulla sua porta si presenta Julie, una sua ex scappatella che gli lascia la figlia stravolgendogli la vita.

programme.title: James Tont Operazione D.U.E.
programme.desc: Un pericoloso gruppo criminale vuole distruggere la basilica di San Pietro seguendo un piano chiamato Operazione DUE, Distruzione Urbe Eterna. L'unico che può fermarli è l'agente segreto James Tont. Con il mitico Lando Buzzanca.

programme.title: Red Dog Linizio
programme.desc: In un villaggio di minatori arriva Red, un simpatico cane randagio dal pelo rosso diventa presto il beniamino del villaggio. Red stravolgerà la vita di tutti ma soprattutto quella di John con la quale instaurerà un rapporto d'amicizia speciale.

programme.title: Big Baby

programme.title: Puntata 3 ǀ 05/01/1963

programme.desc: Bentornati su OPEN WATER! Nel secondo episodio della serie abbiamo un obiettivo ben preciso. Dopo uno scontro perso, torniamo in mare insieme a Pietro Marchi, alla ricerca delle grandi cernie di fondale. Una nuova avventura ci porterà nelle profondità, dove ad attenderci ci sarà una sfida che Pietro aspettava da tempo. Non perdetevi questo episodio e, soprattutto, l'incredibile combattimento con un vero mostro del fondale! Come sempre, consigliamo la visione in 4K per godervi al meglio le immagini, i colori e ogni dettaglio di questa nuova avventura. Buona visione e benvenuti nel mondo di OPEN WATER!

programme.title: Herakles
programme.sub-title: Viaggio nella Terra dei Giganti - Bass fishing in Sardegna
programme.desc: In questo nuovo episodio vi portiamo a riscoprire l'essenza più profonda di un viaggio di pesca in una chiave inedita: la pesca non è solo catturare un pesce o il gigante, ma è storia, cultura e armonia con la natura. La storia di questa avventura nella cosiddetta "Terra dei Giganti", la Sardegna, è raccontata attraverso un viaggio che vi farà vivere da vicino la magia di quest'isola. Partiremo dalle persone speciali che la abitano e dal cibo straordinario, ricco di storia e reinterpretato con creatività da Pedru Caddu, fino a lasciarvi raccontare da Marco cosa significano per lui questa regione e il suo lavoro di guida di pesca.

programme.desc: Cos'è il protocollo PO? L'Istituto di Medicina e Scienza dello Sport del CONI non lascia nulla al caso ed attraverso i parametri definiti dal protocollo stesso analizza tutti gli atleti nei minimi dettagli. programme.desc: Campionessa italiana a soli sedici anni, Giulia racconta una quotidianità fatta di allenamenti infiniti, scuola, amiche e musica. Sogna Los Angeles 2028 con l'entusiasmo di chi non conosce la paura e la grazia di chi trasforma la fatica in danza.

programme.title: FATE
programme.desc: Tra infortuni e rinascite, Asia racconta la ginnasta e la donna che è diventata. Dietro le medaglie, la paura di cadere e la volontà di non arrendersi mai. La sorella Alice come rifugio, la squadra come famiglia, e la mente come il vero attrezzo da allenare.

programme.title: Challange Assoluto, Italiani Assoluti su Pista e Marcia su Strada 2026
One strike, One story by Simone Alessio
programme.desc: Il video è un'immersione psicologica nell'istante decisivo che ha regalato a Simone Alessio la medaglia di bronzo ai Giochi Olimpici di Parigi 2024. Non si tratta solo di sport, ma di un racconto sulla gestione del silenzio e del tempo. Attraverso un racconto intimo e riflessivo, Simone ricostruisce la densità degli ultimi istanti, descrivendo il totale isolamento sensoriale e la lucidità estrema necessari per dominare la pressione del tempo in un atto di pura volontà mentale.

programme.title: One strike, one story by Claudio Nolano
programme.desc: In questo contributo, il Direttore Tecnico Claudio Nolano spoglia il successo sportivo della sua aura di casualità. Attraverso una riflessione profonda che lega il suo passato da atleta al presente da guida tecnica, Nolano esplora il confine tra superstizione e preparazione. Il focus si sposta dal "colpo di fortuna" alla consistenza del lavoro, ridefinendo la vittoria non come un evento fortuito, ma come il risultato inevitabile di un'analisi maniacale di ogni variabile.

programme.title: Sport is My Life
programme.desc: Nel ritmo esplosivo della ginnastica aerobica, si accendono i riflettori su talenti che fondono cuore e acrobazie. Alice D'Amato, Manila Esposito, e Nicola Bartolini rappresentano l'Italia con sequenze mozzafiato e potenza inesauribile. Ayşe Begüm Onbaşı, Rebecca Andrade ed Ellie Black aggiungono un flair internazionale. Ogni intervista rivela cuori instancabili: ritmi forsennati, salti tripli, tra sudore, resilienza e trionfi agonistici. "Sport is my life" mostra come il corpo diventi musica e i limiti si dissolvano in ogni battito.

programme.title: Sport is My Life
programme.desc: Nel cuore pulsante della ginnastica, i riflettori si accendono su un gruppo di atleti che trasformano tecnica e carattere in spettacolo puro. Asia D'Amato guida la scena con eleganza e determinazione, mentre Macchini e Perotti disegnano linee perfette tra controllo, coraggio e precisione. Francesco Sebastio e Vito Iaia portano l'energia esplosiva della ginnastica aerobica, dove ogni secondo è ritmo, potenza e resistenza. Tra esercizi ad alta intensità, salti che sfidano la gravità e concentrazione assoluta, le interviste svelano il lato più vero: sacrifici quotidiani, infortuni superati, sogni olimpici e una fame che non si spegne mai. “Sport is my life” racconta un'Italia che vola, combatte e si rialza, dove il corpo diventa linguaggio e ogni gesto è un battito di vita.
